prompt: Generate a high-fidelity desktop homepage UI concept, edge to edge 1536x1024, for Reel Finisher, free private browser media tools. Option C is workflow-led: the finishing sequence is the visual structure. Render a finished usable website, not a poster, no browser or device frame. Quiet narrow left sidebar shows product name Reel Finisher and labeled navigation Home, All tools, Photos, Video, Audio, AI tools, Privacy. Main area begins with a compact strong headline 'From source to finished.' and the supporting line 'Professional media tools. Right in your browser.' Buttons 'Explore tools' and 'Open Studio'. Below, a single large purposeful workbench arranged horizontally: Source on the left with a beautiful genuine photo, Configure in a slimmer middle with file format and quality controls, Result on the right with the same image preview and 'Ready to download'. Caption this whole bench 'Sample workflow' and use no made-up size or savings claims. After the bench: an asymmetric editorial index of selected working tools: Image Compressor/Resizer/Converter in one collection, Video Compressor/Trim Video in a second, Audio Cutter/Noise Remover in a third. At bottom a flat local-processing explanation and supported-format link. Visual identity: neutral charcoal dark room, warm muted amber as a sparing action highlight, large off-white compact editorial grotesk typography paired with precise readable body text. Distinct generous composition with real media as the hero, no nested cards, repeated icon tiles, large empty regions, gradients, glows, green accent or analytics metrics. Controls and output must look like a media utility, not a timeline editor.
role: design concept; not actual application output
